$comment: Single source of truth for the 10 Hz FeatureFrame. Swift FeatureFrame.swift is GENERATED from this file by gen_feature_frame.py. Order = model input order. Do not reorder without retraining.

features.name: faceDetected
features.desc: 1 if a face anchor is tracked this frame

features.name: gazeYaw
features.desc: lookAtPoint direction yaw in camera space (+ = user's left)

features.name: headYaw
features.desc: face anchor yaw relative to camera

features.name: gazeDeviation
features.desc: angular distance of combined gaze+head direction outside the calibrated work-zone cone (0 inside)

features.name: inWorkZone
features.desc: 1 if gaze is inside the work zone

features.name: offZoneDwell
features.desc: seconds continuously outside the work zone (0 when inside)

features.name: blinkRate
features.desc: blinks per minute over trailing 60 s

features.name: blinkMeanDuration
features.desc: mean blink duration over trailing 60 s

features.name: perclos
features.desc: fraction of frames with eye closure > 0.8 over trailing 60 s

features.name: yawnCount
features.desc: yawn events (jawOpen > 0.6 sustained >= 1.5 s) in trailing 60 s

features.name: yawnActive
features.desc: 1 while a yawn is in progress

features.name: nodCount
features.desc: head-nod events (pitch drop >= 0.25 rad then recovery within 2 s) in trailing 60 s

features.name: phonePickup
features.desc: 1 while Core Motion reports the phone has been picked up / tilted out of its resting pose

features.name: headMotion
features.desc: head angular speed, used to gate rPPG

features.name: heartRateQuality
features.desc: rPPG signal-quality index derived from spectral SNR (0 if unavailable)

features.name: heartRateDelta
features.desc: heartRate minus personal resting baseline (0 if unavailable)
